action_items: Optional / non-blocking: derive Stripe webhook URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (carry-over minor from iteration_1).
No blocking action items — both features in this review request are working as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: maker_auth.py reads MAKER_AUTH_SECRET at import time via os.environ[...]; if .env not loaded before import this raises KeyError. Acceptable here because server.py loads dotenv first, but risky if maker_auth is imported outside the FastAPI process — consider deferring lookup or providing a clearer error.

POST /api/maker/auth/request returns 200 even for invalid email shapes only because Pydantic EmailStr validates first (returns 422). This is correct, but worth a code comment so the no-enumeration guarantee isn't accidentally weakened later.
GET /api/maker/orders does an O(N) scan over all paid payment_transactions and a per-line dict lookup; fine for current scale but should be indexed (or filtered server-side) once volume grows.
